# QA_REPORT — Next generated-type bootstrap

Change: next-generated-types-bootstrap

QA: FAIL

UI_AFFECTING: NO

BROWSER_QA_REQUIRED: NO

Browser QA: NOT_APPLICABLE

Scope: local non-browser repository/tooling/runtime QA only.

## Environment and evidence

Windows, Node 24.17.0, pnpm 11.8.0, installed Next 16.2.9. Faithful current-candidate snapshot `865cbf67a33acd02bd6e2f9c1d09bafe1839a886` at `D:/working/yuta/.tmp-bootstrap-phase3-20260904`; no copied generated/incremental cache or real env. Synthetic CI env for cloud builds. Docker preflight available, not an offline acceptance result.

[Raw commands](../03-phase3-evidence.json), [snapshot inventory](../03-phase3-baseline.json), [stop findings](../03-phase3-review.md), [Technical Compliance Matrix](../03-verify.md).

| Scenario                                        | Actual result                                               |

| Six actual Next generators                      | PASS                                                        |
| Six individual app typechecks                   | PASS                                                        |
| Root generation → recursive typecheck           | PASS                                                        |
| Six actual builds                               | PASS; Display NFT tracing warning retained                  |
| Typegen/build regeneration and exact ignores    | PASS for tested modes, 2200/2200 tracked bytes unchanged    |
| Actual Backoffice config throw                  | FAIL diagnostic: later generators + recursive check ran     |
| Negative fixture integrity                      | FAIL: LF/CRLF byte drift; not accepted as faithful evidence |
| Other five actual failure positions             | NOT_EXECUTED_AFTER_STOP                                     |
| Missing-package negative                        | NOT_EXECUTED_AFTER_STOP                                     |
| Six dev Ready/generation checks                 | NOT_EXECUTED_AFTER_STOP                                     |
| README Git/SHA negative control                 | NOT_EXECUTED_AFTER_STOP                                     |
| Full POS offline, next-env absent               | NOT_EXECUTED_AFTER_STOP                                     |
| Full POS offline, next-env already generated    | NOT_EXECUTED_AFTER_STOP                                     |

## Critical observations

The first negative run ended nonzero only because downstream Backoffice TypeScript could not resolve SVG declarations. It did not stop at the injected typegen error. Process trace proves both five later generators and recursive TypeScript invocation. This is not a passing fail-fast test.

This negative fixture additionally failed raw-byte provenance: Git checkout converted LF to CRLF under core.autocrlf=true, and before-test protection was omitted. Original repository/main success snapshot protected hashes remain intact. Diagnostic failure is recorded honestly, not accepted as qualified six-case evidence.

No Browser QA/screenshots are claimed or required for this tooling change. No POS acceptance container, real data, API mutation, production operation or deployment was executed. Remaining fixtures/dev/offline tests were not started after mandatory stop.

## Closure

QA cannot PASS. This is not BLOCKED_BY_ENVIRONMENT: the observed failure and fixture-protocol violation are the stop reasons; Docker availability has not been disproved.

Gate 3 NOT_PREPARED. Human technical review required before remediation/revalidation. Formalités remains blocked from sync/archive and its protected artifacts were not regenerated.
